From: Femi Vasquez
Sent: Monday 8:14 AM
To: Litigation Associates; Litigation Paralegals; Will Jaramillo; Xavier Jovanovic; Kenji Dube; Kemi Iversen; Darius Whitcombe
Subject: Project Driftwood - Firmwide Update
When: Wednesday 4:00 PM - 4:30 PM
Where: Main Conference Room / Video link to follow

Colleagues,

On behalf of the Management Committee of Oyelaran Hollander Law Group, I am pleased to invite you to a brief session regarding Project Driftwood.

As many of you are aware, there has been considerable discussion in recent weeks concerning the initiative and its implications for the practice. The purpose of this session is to provide clarity on the direction the firm intends to take and to ensure that all personnel receive consistent information at the same time.

Partners Will Jaramillo and Kemi Iversen will offer remarks. Time permitting, there will be an opportunity for questions, although we ask that matters relating to individual circumstances be raised with Darius Whitcombe separately.

Please note: this information is CONFIDENTIAL and should NOT be discussed with clients or opposing counsel prior to formal communication.

We appreciate your attendance and your continued commitment to the firm.

Regards,
Femi Vasquez
